comparison.objective: Add a padlock to an occupied group-lockout hasp without disturbing the coworker’s lock; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Shackle alignment, insertion and snapping around an articulated hasp versus recessed hex-key insertion, collar rotation and controlled tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Added lock survives hasp and switch-load tests versus damper passes repeated impact and setting-drift tests.
comparison.reason: Different objective, mechanism and verification despite a shared locking primitive. No material rubric detail is missing.
